tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Built a full-stack trading platform across three services: marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API using JWT-based authentication with httpOnly cookies.
Added Joi-based request validation on authentication and order endpoints and deployed the full stack using Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team at Mogi IO, I am writing to apply for the Backend Developer Intern position. As an MCA student at PES University with practical experience in backend development using Node.js and MongoDB, I am eager to contribute to your core video and image technology workflows. During my professional experience as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Sunflower Trip, I built production-ready applications utilizing Node.js, Express, and MySQL with secure role-based access control. Additionally, my project work includes developing Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform featuring an Express API, JWT-based authentication, and MongoDB Atlas deployment, as well as StaySphere, which incorporates Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Joi-based request validation. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to bring my hands-on backend coding experience to Mogi IO and support your video delivery SaaS platform. Thank you for your time and consideration.
